# Kiru 2.x — declarative router (LLM reference)

For Kiru 1.x (FileRouter) see https://kirujs.dev/llms.txt

## Overview

Kiru 2.x uses an explicit route tree (`defineRouteTree` in `src/routes.ts`), mode-specific client bootstrap, and `vite-plugin-kiru` `router.*` options. Human docs: https://kirujs.dev/v2/docs/

Install: `npm install kiru` and `npm install -D vite-plugin-kiru`. SSR/hybrid: `npm install @kirujs/adapter-node`.

## Route tree

```ts
import { defineRouteTree } from "kiru/router"

export const routes = defineRouteTree((r) =>
  r.scope({
    layout: () => import("./pages/layout.tsx"),
    notFound: () => import("./pages/not-found.tsx"),
    children: [
      r.page("/", () => import("./pages/index.tsx")),
      r.page("/users/[id]", () => import("./pages/user.tsx")),
    ],
  })
)
```

## Bootstrap by mode

| Mode | Import | API |
|------|--------|-----|
| CSR | `kiru/router/csr` | `createRouterApp({ routes, container })` |
| SSG client | `kiru/ssr/router` | `bootstrapSsgClient({ routes, container })` |
| SSR client | `kiru/router/ssr` | `createRouterApp({ routes, container })` |

## Vite plugin

```ts
kiru({ router: { ssg: true } })
kiru({ router: { serverEntry: "./src/server.ts" } })
kiru({ router: { ssg: true, serverEntry: "./src/server.ts" } }) // hybrid
```

SSG requires root `index.html` with `{{kiru_head}}` and `{{kiru_body}}`.

## SSR server

```ts
import { createKiruHandler } from "@kirujs/adapter-node"
import { routes } from "./routes"

const kiru = createKiruHandler({ importMetaUrl: import.meta.url, routes, dev: true })
export default { fetch: kiru.fetch }
```

## Navigation

- `Link`, `useRouter()` from `kiru/router`
- `useSearchParams()` when loader defines `validation.query`
- `router.invalidate()` refetches loaders

## Upgrading from Kiru 1.x

- `FileRouter` + `import.meta.glob` → `defineRouteTree`
- `useFileRouter` → `useRouter`
- `kiru({ ssg: true })` → `kiru({ router: { ssg: true } })`
- `document.tsx` → `index.html` template tokens

Guide: https://kirujs.dev/v2/docs/migration

## Limitations

- `serverLoader` on CSR navigations needs SSR loader endpoint
- `CustomRequestContext` is SSR-only
- Cloudflare Workers: no time-based ISR
